description: Defines the VideoFrameFactoryImpl class responsible for creating and managing video frames backed by CodecOutputBuffer, with functionality for eager rendering and surface management in Android GPU context.

classes.name: VideoFrameFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implements a factory for creating CodecOutputBuffer-backed VideoFrames, with mechanisms for eager rendering and surface management, designed for Android GPU video decoding.

methods.name: VideoFrameFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with GPU thread, preferences, image provider, and helper components.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the factory with overlay mode and callback.

methods.name: SetSurfaceBundle
methods.description: Sets the surface bundle for video frames.

methods.name: CreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a video frame from output buffer with timestamp and size.

methods.name: RunAfterPendingVideoFrames
methods.description: Runs a callback after pending video frames are processed.

methods.name: SetCodecBufferWaitCorrdinatorForTesting
methods.description: Sets the buffer wait coordinator for testing purposes.
